svg.title: Thermomechanical nanomolding and differential nanorod growth
svg.desc: A nanoporous mold is pressed onto an alloy microstructure between heated plates. A selected region is magnified on the right. Color-coded rods grow to different heights above different grains, illustrating spatial variations in local pore filling. The mold is omitted in the magnified view for clarity. A twelve-second loop shows compression, magnification and rod growth. Heights are schematic, not experimental data. The background is transparent.

g.text: A nanoporous mold is pressed against the alloy.
Different local filling rates produce different rod heights.
